The presence of illegible gibberish instead of clear advertising or markings further degrades alignment with the 'typical' appearance of an airship. Structural collapse at the tail fins (Severity 3.0) and texture anomalies on the hull (Severity 2.5) indicate poor geometric and material synthesis.
